intended_object: The map Max(A) → Spa(A, A°) for an affinoid K-algebra A, where K is a complete nonarchimedean field. It sends a maximal ideal 𝔪 to its classical point: the unique extension of the norm of K to the finite extension A/𝔪, pulled back along A → A/𝔪 (Wedhorn, Example 7.58).
